ques: From the homepage, use the Camping & Lodging tab to search Yosemite campgrounds. Open both Yosemite Creek Campground and Porcupine Flat Campground, determine which one is currently open for the featured trip window, and report one activity from the available campground.
judge_rubric: Open BOTH the Yosemite Creek Campground and Porcupine Flat Campground detail pages. Yosemite Creek Campground is the one open for the featured window (Porcupine Flat is unavailable). The answer MUST identify Yosemite Creek as open and name one of its activities (Camping, Waterfalls, or Hiking). An empty answer, or naming Porcupine Flat as open, is a FAIL.

ques: Search for Point Reyes camping and open Point Reyes National Seashore Campground. In the Media Gallery, report two different scenes shown in the gallery images.
judge_rubric: Open the Point Reyes National Seashore Campground detail page and view its Media Gallery. The answer MUST describe two DISTINCT gallery scenes (e.g. the large oak tree, the campsite with distant Drakes Bay views, the campsite with picnic table and bear box). An empty answer is a FAIL.

ques: Search California wilderness permits and compare the likely permit results until you find the listing whose detail page combines Fishing in the activity pills with Trailhead Entry in the listing details. Report the permit name and the parent area.
judge_rubric: Open the Inyo National Forest Wilderness Permits detail page (the California permit whose detail combines a Fishing activity pill with Trailhead Entry). The answer MUST report the permit name 'Inyo National Forest Wilderness Permits' and parent area 'Inyo National Forest'. An empty answer is a FAIL.

ques: Search for San Francisco tours and compare San Francisco Maritime Historic Park Tours with Fort Point National Historic Site Tours. Which listing highlights Historic Ships, and which one is part of Golden Gate National Recreation Area?
judge_rubric: Open BOTH the San Francisco Maritime Historic Park Tours and Fort Point National Historic Site Tours detail pages. The answer MUST state that SF Maritime highlights Historic Ships and that Fort Point is part of Golden Gate National Recreation Area. An empty answer is a FAIL.

ques: Use the Explore By State section on the homepage to browse Alaska inventory. Find the Sitka reservable cabin whose detail page lists both Boat Access and Wood Stove, and report its name.
judge_rubric: Browse Alaska inventory (Explore By State) and open the Hemlock Cabin detail page (the Sitka cabin listing Boat Access and Wood Stove). The answer MUST name Hemlock Cabin. An empty answer is a FAIL.

ques: From Explore Most Popular Locations on the homepage, open Apostle Islands Camping Permits under Apostle Islands National Lakeshore. Report one activity shown on that detail page and whether the listing is a permit or a campground.
judge_rubric: Open the Apostle Islands Camping Permits detail page. The answer MUST name one activity shown (Island Camping, Kayaking, or Lakes) AND state that the listing is a permit (not a campground). An empty answer is a FAIL.

ques: Open the Help Center and find the policy point about online reservation fees. Which kind of reservation typically includes a $1 online reservation fee?
judge_rubric: Open the Help Center and read the policy point about online reservation fees. The answer MUST identify TICKET reservations as the kind that typically includes a $1 online reservation fee. An empty answer is a FAIL.

ques: Use Inspiration & Information to open Plan Ahead and Play It Safe for Your Next Outdoor Adventure. According to the article, what are the three checks travelers should make before committing to a long drive?
judge_rubric: Open the 'Plan Ahead and Play It Safe for Your Next Outdoor Adventure' article. The answer MUST name the three checks a strong plan starts with: the inventory type, the allowed date window, and the agency rules. An empty answer is a FAIL.

ques: Open the America250 inspiration article and list any three places it mentions.
judge_rubric: Open the America250 inspiration article. The answer MUST name at least THREE places mentioned on the page (e.g. San Francisco Maritime, Fort Point, Golden Gate, Yosemite, Yellowstone, Denali, Cumberland Island). An empty answer is a FAIL.

ques: Browse passes and compare the Yosemite, Denali, and Grand Teton site pass pages. Which one includes the extra note that non-U.S. residents must pay an additional fee?
judge_rubric: Open and compare the Yosemite, Denali, and Grand Teton site pass pages. The answer MUST identify the Yosemite National Park Site Pass as the one carrying the note that non-U.S. residents must pay an additional fee. An empty answer is a FAIL.

ques: Use Tickets & Tours to find the Minnesota listing whose detail page includes Accessible Seating instead of Accessible Route. Report the listing name and parent area.
judge_rubric: Open the Voyageurs National Park Tours detail page (the Minnesota Tickets & Tours listing showing Accessible Seating rather than Accessible Route). The answer MUST name the listing and its parent area, Voyageurs National Park. An empty answer is a FAIL.

ques: Log in as alice.j@test.com with password TestPass123!, find Fort Point National Historic Site Tours, save it, and confirm it appears in Saved locations.
judge_rubric: Log in as alice, open the Fort Point National Historic Site Tours detail page, save it, and open Saved locations. The Fort Point listing MUST be saved to alice's account. FAIL if the save was not performed.

ques: Log in as bob.c@test.com with password TestPass123! and complete checkout for the item already in the cart. Then open Reservations and report the new confirmation code.
judge_rubric: Log in as bob, complete checkout for the item already in the cart (Lake Powhatan Glamping), and open Reservations. A NEW reservation MUST exist for bob and the answer MUST report its new confirmation code. FAIL if checkout was not completed or the cart is unchanged.

ques: Log in as alice.j@test.com with password TestPass123! and cancel only the upcoming Kirby Cove Campground reservation, leaving the Yellowstone National Park Fishing Permit reservation untouched. Report the confirmation code that was cancelled.
judge_rubric: Log in as alice and cancel ONLY the Kirby Cove Campground reservation. Kirby Cove MUST end up Cancelled while the Yellowstone fishing permit reservation stays Upcoming; the answer MUST report the cancelled code RG-2026-AJ01. FAIL if the wrong reservation was cancelled or none was.

ques: Log in as carol.d@test.com with password TestPass123!, update the account phone number to 555-0199 and the home city to Boulder, then confirm both updated values on the account page.
judge_rubric: Log in as carol and update the account phone to 555-0199 and home city to Boulder. BOTH values MUST persist on carol's account page. FAIL if either was not updated.

ques: Create a new account using display name River Stone, username river_stone, email river.stone@example.com, and password TrailPass2026. After the account is created, report the default card ending and the default address city shown on the account page.
judge_rubric: Create the new account (River Stone / river_stone / river.stone@example.com) and open the account page. The account MUST be created and the answer MUST report the default card ending 4242 and default address city Denver. An empty answer is a FAIL.

ques: Log in as david.k@test.com with password TestPass123!, open Fort Point National Historic Site Tours, submit a 4-star review with visit date May 2026 and the note 'Accessible route was easy to follow.', and confirm that your review appears with the Your review badge.
judge_rubric: Log in as david, open Fort Point National Historic Site Tours, and submit a 4-star review with the note 'Accessible route was easy to follow.'. The review MUST be saved on Fort Point (author David Kim, 4 stars, that note). FAIL if no such review was submitted.

ques: Search for Cumberland Island beach camping and open Cumberland Island Camping Permits. Report the state and one activity listed on its detail page.
judge_rubric: Open the Cumberland Island Camping Permits detail page. The answer MUST report the state (Georgia) and one activity shown (Beach Camping, Wilderness, or Wildlife Viewing). An empty answer is a FAIL.

ques: Search for BLM-managed permits and find the wilderness listing near Winkelman. Open the detail page and report one activity plus whether the listing mentions Day Use Permit, Overnight Permit, or both.
judge_rubric: Open the Aravaipa Canyon Wilderness Permits detail page (the BLM wilderness listing near Winkelman). The answer MUST name one activity (Canyons, Hiking, or Wildlife Viewing) AND state that the listing mentions BOTH a Day Use Permit and an Overnight Permit. An empty answer is a FAIL.

ques: Log in as alice.j@test.com with password TestPass123!, find Yellowstone National Park Fishing Permit, open its detail page, add it to the cart, and confirm the pass appears in Your cart.
judge_rubric: Log in as alice, open the Yellowstone National Park Fishing Permit detail page, add it to the cart, and open the cart. The permit MUST be present in alice's cart. FAIL if it was not added.
